EventItemActionText:
BOARD OF ARCHITECTURAL REVIEW

The Board of Architectural Review met in a regular session on Thursday, May 21,  2026, at 7:30 p.m. in Town Hall, 127 Center St S, Vienna, VA 22180.
Roll Call: Ms. Couchman, Ms. Shelly, Mr. Penati, Mr. O’Keefe, and Ms. Hanley were present. 

Staff present: Planner Sharmaine Abaied, and Board Clerk Jennifer Murphy.

Item No. 1: Request approval of arbors, bridge, shed, and mulch, as well as a new sign for Salsbury Spring Park, located at the corner of Lawyers Rd NW & Windover Ave. NW, Docket No. PF-2151939-BAR, in RS-16, Single Family Residential zoning district, filed by Leslie Herman Town of Vienna’s Director of Parks and Recreation, project contact.

Applicant present: Leslie Herman, Sam Butz, and Debbie Fay 

Ms. Herman explained that the proposal includes installation of a shed, two arbors, a bridge over the spring area, engineered wood mulch paths, and an updated park sign for Salisbury Spring Park. She stated the project is being coordinated with the Ayr Hill Garden Club and is intended to improve the appearance and accessibility of the park while creating a stronger identity as a public park rather than a subdivision entrance feature.

Ms. Herman described the location of the proposed improvements, including one arbor near the Windover Avenue entrance and another near the Lawyers Road entrance, which would serve as the accessible entry point. She noted the engineered wood mulch is ADA compliant and commonly used on playground facilities.
There were no comments from the board or the public. 

Board members discussed the updated sign design, accessibility considerations, and the proposed materials for the improvements. The Board also discussed the distinction between park signage and subdivision-style signage.

There were no public comments.

Mr. O’Keefe made a motion to approve the arbors, bridge, shed, and mulch for Salsbury Spring Park, located at the corner of Lawyers Rd NW & Windover Ave. NW, Docket No. PF-2151939-BAR, in RS-16, Single Family Residential zoning district, filed by Leslie Herman Town of Vienna’s Director of Parks and Recreation, project contact., with the following conditions:
•	Specification sheets for the Arbor, Bridge, and Shed be provided to staff
•	No signs be installed relating to ADA accessibility.

Motion: Mr. O’Keefe
Second: Ms. Shelly 
Motion Carried (5-0)
EventItemTitle:
Lawyers Rd NW & Windover Ave NW- Salsbury Spring Park
Exterior Modifications & Sign

Item No. 4: Request approval of a new wall sign, and gooseneck lights for Modalika Custom Tailoring, located at 145 Church St NW., Docket No. PF-2132087-BAR, in the CS Church Street zoning district; filed by Rafi Behroozian, Modalika Custom Tailoring, Project Contact.

Applicants Present:  Rafi Behroozian

The applicant presented the proposed wall sign and gooseneck lighting fixtures for the tailoring business. The Board discussed the sign proportions, lighting placement, and compatibility with the surrounding storefronts.

There were no public comments. 

Ms. Shelly made a motion to approve a new wall sign, and gooseneck lights for Modalika Custom Tailoring, located at 145 Church St NW., Docket No. PF-2132087-BAR, in the CS Church Street zoning district; filed by Rafi Behroozian, Modalika Custom Tailoring, Project Contact, with the following conditions:
•	The gooseneck lights be located as follows The gooseneck lights be located as follows
o	Left most light be centered over the icon / logo
o	Right most light be equal distance from the other light
•	The sign be located as follows
o	One brick row below the soldier course of the bottom sill brick of the windows
o	Approximately two brick rows above the lower soldier course of brick

Motion: Ms. Shelly 
Second: Mr. O’Keefe
Motion Carried (5-0)
EventItemTitle: Modalika Custom Tailoring - 145 Church St NW - Sign

Item No. 5: Request approval to reface two wall signs and a new tenant panel, located at 421 Maple Ave E., Docket No. PF-2142888-BAR, in the AE, Avenue East zoning district; filed by Justin Stegall, Bakeshop Vienna, Project Contact.

Applicants Present:  Justin Stegall and Mai Tran

The applicant presented a wall and tenant panel sign for Bakeshop Vienna.  Board members discussed the sign concept, including color, graphic elements and lettering styles, and worked collaboratively with the applicant to simplify the design and improve compatibility with the existing shopping center architecture.  The Board members inquired about the desired color for the tenant panel to which the business owners stated they prefer the color black.

There were no public comments.

Ms. Couchman made a motion to approve two wall signs and a new tenant panel, located at 421 Maple Ave E., Docket No. PF-2142888-BAR, in the AE, Avenue East zoning district; filed by Justin Stegall, Bakeshop Vienna, Project Contact, with the following conditions:
•	Bakeshop sign approved as submitted
•	Bakery & Cafe sign use title case with uniform kerning and the ampersand be centered between Bakery and Café
•	Black font and a white background be used on the pylon sign

Motion: Ms. Couchman
Second: Mr. O’Keefe
Motion Carried (5-0)
EventItemTitle: Bakeshop Vienna - 421 Maple Ave E - Sign

Item No. 6: Request approval for a walkway and canopy for 132 Branch Rd SE, Docket No. PF-1884023-BAR, in the AE, Avenue East Commercial Zoning district, filed by Yu Zhan of Yu Architecture, project contact.

Applicants Present:  Yu Zhan and Albert Yang

The applicant presented the proposed canopy intended to provide additional weather protection for employees transporting food between buildings during inclement weather conditions. The applicant noted that the Fairfax county health department was requiring a canopy.  Board members discussed the proposed canopy location in relation to the outdoor freezers and the door as well as the door awning. 

There were no public comments.

Ms. Shelly made a motion to approve a walkway and canopy for 132 Branch Rd SE, Docket No. PF-1884023-BAR, in the AE, Avenue East Commercial Zoning district, filed by Yu Zhan of Yu Architecture, project contact, as submitted

Motion: Ms. Shelly
Second: Mr. O’Keefe
Motion Carried (5-0)

Other Business:
WHBR – Ms. Shelly, BAR representative to Windover Heights Board of Review (WHBR) provided Board members with information related to WHBR agenda items. The Board also discussed the membership requirement for WHBR and what is reviewed by WHBR.
Work Session – June 3 work session request discussion.
Wireless Communitation – BAR discussion about wireless communication exterior modification requirements and code language along with Virginia General Assembly legislation passed regarding wireless communication.
Signage – future work session to discuss creating a document to provide to the business community to assit in sign submittals to the BAR.
EventItemTitle: 132 Branch Rd SE - Chef Tan - Exterior Modification
